[![BlakeAllen](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/9/97/BlakeAllen.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20210826035546)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/9/97/BlakeAllen.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20210826035546)
**David Blake Allen** is a former Hot Wheels designer who designed cars for Mattel in 2004 as one of three external designers who designed cars for Hot Wheels. Prior to his leadership position, Blake attended Western Hills High School from 1987-1989. In 1999, he completed his Bachelor of Science in Industrial Design from the University of Cincinnati. He currently works as a Senior Lead Designer at General Motors, a position he has held since 2010.

Blake Allen was a former classmate of [Eric Tscherne](/wiki/Eric_Tscherne).
